name: altium-copilot
description: AI copilot for Altium Designer (Windows only). Reads live schematics from a running Altium instance — trace nets, inspect components, switch variants, and run structured design reviews, all from Claude. Requires Altium Designer installed and running on Windows.

tools.name: detect_altium_project
tools.description: Detect whether Altium Designer is running, which project is currently open, and list previously loaded projects from the local registry. Always call this first to orient Claude before loading a project.

tools.name: get_clone_status
tools.description: Show where the project's local copy stands against Altium 365, read offline from its Git clone: project GUID, last fetch time, commits ahead or behind as of that fetch, uncommitted local changes and the last commit, with a warning when the last fetch is old. Never fetches.

tools.name: set_project_dir
tools.description: Load an Altium project from disk given its folder path. Parses the .PrjPcb file, reads all schematic sheets, and generates a Protel netlist by automating Altium's export. Required before calling any other tool. Altium Designer must have the project open when the netlist has to be generated; with Altium closed and no up-to-date netlist, the project loads partially: board, rule, notes and variant tools work, netlist tools answer netlist_required.

tools.name: refresh_netlist
tools.description: Regenerate the netlist after the user saves schematic changes in Altium. Only call when the user confirms they have saved — do not call speculatively.

tools.name: query_net
tools.description: Find nets by name and return every component pin connected to them. Accepts a case-insensitive regex for discovery (e.g. 'UART' finds all UART nets, 'GND' finds GND/AGND/DGND). If the pattern contains regex metacharacters and is invalid (e.g. +5V, +3V3, VIN[0]), falls back to exact case-insensitive match automatically. High-fanout nets like power rails are flagged and sampled. Use this to discover net names or trace a specific net across sheets.

tools.name: get_component
tools.description: Get full detail for a component by reference designator (e.g. U1, R14). Returns the MPN, value, DNP status, and every pin with its connected net.

tools.name: search_components
tools.description: Search components using a regex pattern against refdes, MPN, or description. Results are grouped by MPN with per-group counts — useful for finding all instances of a part or all components matching a description.

tools.name: get_sheet_context
tools.description: Get all components on a schematic sheet with their pin-to-net connections and cross-sheet neighbors, plus the designer's notes on that sheet. Results are paginated — if has_more:true, use the offset from the next: line to call again. Pass a sheet name or omit to use the currently active sheet in Altium.

tools.name: get_design_notes
tools.description: Read the information designers added besides the circuit: project parameters, schematic notes, text frames, labels, pictures, directives and title blocks, and Draftsman fabrication/assembly notes, tables, view titles, drill table and layer stack notes. Paginated; pass a sheet or Draftsman document name to read one document.

tools.name: get_design_image
tools.description: Show a picture placed on a schematic sheet or in a Draftsman drawing (e.g. a pasted datasheet excerpt or block diagram) as an image Claude can look at.

tools.name: list_variants
tools.description: List all project variants and their DNP (Do Not Populate) component lists. Returns variant names and which components are excluded in each.

tools.name: set_active_variant
tools.description: Switch the active variant by name. DNP annotations update immediately and all subsequent tool calls reflect the new variant's populated/excluded components.

tools.name: schematic_review
tools.description: Start a structured 3-phase schematic review: power integrity, signal integrity, and BOM/variant sanity. Automatically triggered when the user asks Claude to review the schematic.

tools.name: brainstorm_circuits
tools.description: Start a structured 5-phase circuit brainstorming session: requirements, topology options, component selection, tradeoffs, and next steps. Automatically triggered when the user asks Claude to brainstorm a circuit.

tools.name: package_for_xfn
tools.description: Export the current schematic project to a portable SQLite .db snapshot that cross-functional team members (firmware, mechanical, test, reliability) can query with pcb-copilot. Only call when the user explicitly asks to package or export the project for sharing.

tools.name: get_board_info
tools.description: Return the saved PCB document's board extents, coordinate origin, copper stackup, object counts, parser warnings, and PCB/netlist timestamps. Call this first for layout questions and warn when PCB and schematic freshness differ.

tools.name: get_net_pcb
tools.description: Return physical routing for an exact PCB net, including per-layer length and width, vias, pad endpoints, polygon outlines, bounding box, and active-variant DNP annotations. A regex may be used to discover multiple net names.

tools.name: get_net_neighbors
tools.description: Find same-layer copper within a distance of a PCB net and nets overlapping its route on adjacent copper layers. Results are geometric facts, not a crosstalk severity judgment; polygon overlap uses saved nominal outlines.

tools.name: query_pcb_region
tools.description: Return nearby PCB nets, components, and saved nominal polygon outlines around a coordinate, optionally on one copper layer. Repour polygons and save before relying on polygon results.

tools.name: get_component_placement
tools.description: Return one or more physical PCB instances for a reference designator, including coordinates, side, rotation, bounds, pad nets, nearby components, channel mapping, and active-variant DNP annotations.

tools.name: get_design_rules
tools.description: List the PCB design rules saved in the PcbDoc by kind, priority and scope, or show a kind or rule with its values: widths, gaps, clearance matrix, per-layer values, and stale scope references.

tools.name: get_rules_for_net
tools.description: Resolve which design rules apply to a net or differential pair, the way Altium does by priority: the effective rule per kind with values, conditional overrides, and clearance candidates.

tools.name: get_classes
tools.description: List the PCB's net, component, differential-pair, pad and xSignal classes, or show one class's members with unresolved members and DNP flags.

tools.name: list_diff_pairs
tools.description: List differential pairs with their nets, classes, length per leg (pad-to-pad path plus via barrels) and skew, and the routing rule that applies to each pair.

tools.name: check_rule_compliance
tools.description: Check saved copper against the design rules per object: track widths per layer (diff-pair nets against their routing rule), via diameter and hole, via hole size and annular ring, routing layers and Length windows; optional approximate clearance spot-check. Groups violations and says whether the board's own batch DRC checks each kind.

tools.name: check_lengths
tools.description: Evaluate Length and MatchedLengths rules like Altium: length windows, matched-length groups of xSignals, pairs or nets against the longest member or target, and within-pair skew, measured as pad-to-pad copper path plus via barrels.

tools.name: get_signal_length
tools.description: Measure one net, differential pair, xSignal or pin-to-pin path on the saved copper, including via barrels, with per-layer lengths and unrouted gaps.

tools.name: check_diff_pairs
tools.description: Check differential-pair consistency: undeclared P/N pairs, polarity swaps at component pins (with interface hints), series parts and AC coupling symmetry, and in-pair skew against within-pair rules.

tools.name: check_sch_pcb_sync
tools.description: Offline schematic-vs-PCB sync check, like Altium's Show Differences: parts missing from or extra on the PCB, designator, footprint and comment differences, pads on the wrong net, renamed and one-sided nets, and schematic pins whose footprint has no pad (Update PCB's 'Unknown Pin').

tools.name: check_decoupling
tools.description: Offline decoupling coverage: rails with no capacitor to ground, only Not Fitted ones, or fed through a ferrite without their own, and (with the PcbDoc) capacitors far from IC power pads or on the other side without a via.

tools.name: check_pcb_health
tools.description: Altium's PCB Health Check Monitor offline: shelved or modified polygons, duplicate designators, zero-area polygons and regions, self-intersecting regions, micro-segments, slot holes, xSignals, 360-degree and off-board components, reference points outside the component, compared with the last DRC report's health section.

tools.name: check_vias
tools.description: Via inventory and fab review: via types by span, hole and pad with counts per type and net class, aspect ratio, annular ring, via-in-pad, tenting, drill pairs, and back drilling with the via stubs it leaves.

tools.name: check_connectivity
tools.description: Offline copper connectivity, like Altium's Un-Routed Net and Net Antennae rules: per net, whether the saved copper (tracks, vias, pads, poured copper, regions, fills, internal planes) joins all its pads, routing progress, each missing connection with its nearest pads and gap, floating copper and net antennae, beside Altium's last DRC report.

tools.name: get_drc_report
tools.description: Read Altium's last Batch DRC report (HTML or .drc): violations grouped by rule, component or net and linked to the board, PCB health issues and waivers, with an assessment of whether to trust it (stopped at the violation limit, rule kinds not checked, older than the board).

tools.name: get_bom
tools.description: Bill of materials per variant from the compiled parts: lines with quantity, designators, Comment, footprint, manufacturer and MPN (from part parameters), without Not Fitted and no-BOM parts; variant comparison and CSV.

tools.name: check_bom
tools.description: Offline BOM hygiene checks: duplicate designators, unresolved special strings, DNP markers on fitted parts, missing footprints, inconsistent or missing MPNs and manufacturers, placeholder descriptions, stale variant entries and consolidation candidates.

tools.name: constraints_review
tools.description: Start a structured 4-phase review of the PCB's high-speed constraints: identifies interfaces from parts and pins, takes targets from each chip's layout guide, checks pairs, classes, impedance-driven rules, matched-length groups, clearances, reference layers and stale rules, then spot-checks the saved copper. Checks saved rules and copper; quotes Altium's last DRC report only with its assessment. Automatically triggered when the user asks Claude to check the board's high-speed constraints.
